about: Stills of the Lens & Distort pages (docs/Features/effects/<id>.md): compare pairs and preset strips. Make them with node scripts/docs-media.mjs <effect id>.

pairs.name: lens-correction
pairs.alt: The rainy night street as a strong wide-angle lens bends it, original left and with Lens Correction right: on the left the shop fronts at both edges bow outward like a barrel; on the right they stand straight and upright, the street runs straight to the vanishing point and the picture is slightly enlarged
pairs.caption: Left: a shot from a strong wide-angle lens. Right: Distortion −28, Scale 120 (the Action Cam preset).

pairs.name: guided-perspective
pairs.alt: The rainy night street photographed with the camera tilted up, original left and with Guided Perspective right: on the left the house edges on both sides lean in towards the top; on the right they stand upright and parallel, and the picture is enlarged so it still fills the frame
pairs.caption: Left: a photo taken with the camera tilted up. Right: two vertical guides along the house edges, with the Fill Frame preset.

pairs.name: guided-perspective-guides
pairs.alt: The rainy night street photographed with the camera tilted up, the house edges on both sides leaning in towards the top, with two blue guide lines drawn along the left and the right house edge
pairs.note: The page draws the two guides of the guided-perspective pair over this still as SVG (guide editor blue #48b8ff).

pairs.name: fisheye
pairs.alt: The harbour town, original left and with Fisheye Lens at its default settings right: the horizon and the quay bow into one curve across the whole frame, the town in the middle comes closer and the corners stay filled
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: the default settings.

pairs.name: bulge
pairs.alt: The rainy night street with neon signs, original left and with Bulge & Pinch right: on the right the walker with the umbrella in the middle of the street is twice as large, as under a round glass, and the shop fronts around him bow outward, while the edges of the picture stay where they were
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: the default settings.

strips.note: Blue: the transparent outside of Peephole.

handMadeStrips.note: params: the guides and correction drawn on the tilted street, under every preset (presets keep the drawn guides).
handMadeStrips.why: Not in "strips": effect-lab.mjs --presets renders preset values only, without these base params (the drawn guides), so it would make four identical frames. Rendered with a local one-line change (base params under each preset); listed in HAND_MADE (scripts/docsMediaRecipes.mjs) until the shared tooling takes strip params.
